Warning

Deprecation Notice: The Platform Version 202701 (January 2027 release) will be sunset on December 15, 2027. Move to a newer API version before then so your integration keeps working. The migration guide lists the supported versions.

Questions about the migration can be sent to developer support.

November 2027 - Version 202711 (Latest)

Product and Platform Announcements

  • Creatives API: new summary field: Starting with version 202711, the creatives endpoint can return a read-only summary field describing the creative. It is not returned by default; request it with the fields query parameter.
  • Reporting API: wider date range: Analytics queries can now cover up to 24 months in one request.

Breaking Changes

  • Campaign API: new required surface field (action required): Starting with version 202711, creating a placement list requires a surface value. Requests without it fail with a 400 error. Existing accounts have a migration window that ends on January 31, 2028.

Version Sunset

The versions below are scheduled to be sunset on the dates shown.

  • 202610 - October 15, 2027
  • 202611 - November 16, 2027

October 2027 - Version 202710

Product and Platform Announcements

  • Audience API: size estimates: Audience size estimates are now returned with each audience definition.

September 2027 - Version 202709

Product and Platform Announcements

  • Targeting: new facet: A new seniority facet is available for audience targeting.

August 2027 - Version 202708

Product and Platform Announcements

  • Conversions API: Batch uploads accept up to 1,000 events per request.

July 2027 - Version 202707

Product and Platform Announcements

  • Ad accounts: Account status is now included in list responses.

June 2027 - Version 202706

Product and Platform Announcements

  • Lead forms: Form questions can be marked optional.

To learn more about the API changes from earlier years, refer to the archive.
